observations: Photo 0 shows a dusty, grimy compact hi-fi/mini stereo system with '3 DISC' and 'MINISTAR' branding visible on the front panel.
Unit has a CD/disc bay, a dual cassette deck (A/B), and various buttons/knobs, all caked in dust and grime.
A loose wire/cable is visible on the floor to the right, no power adapter is shown in the photo.
Item sits on a bare concrete floor next to a worn sofa and slippers, consistent with a storage/scrap area, not a staged 'working unit' shot.
No photo shows the unit powered on, no display lit, no sound, no close-up of ports or adapter.

read_from: photo 0 front panel badge reading 'MINISTAR' and '3 DISC'

claims.claim: This is a scrap compact audio system that is currently not functioning, sold as-is for parts/recycling.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows heavy dust/grime consistent with disuse, but no power-on test is shown.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: This directly contradicts the seller's own opening description that the unit is 'scrap' and 'not functioning'. No adapter is visible in photo 0, and no power-on or sound test is shown.
No import label, plug type, or voltage sticker is visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Seller's text is internally contradictory (described as non-functioning scrap, then claimed fully working) which is a sign of copy-pasted or misleading boilerplate rather than a genuine working unit.
risks.proof: A video clip of the unit powered on, playing a CD/cassette, with volume audible and all buttons demonstrated.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functioning scrap/parts unit, per the seller's own primary description

risks.risk: No power adapter is visible in the photo despite being claimed as included.
risks.proof: A photo showing the actual adapter/power cable next to the unit with plug type visible.

risks.risk: Internal condition (belts, lasers, capacitors) cannot be assessed from an exterior photo alone.
risks.proof: Photos of the open casing/internals or a technician's inspection report.

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, broken hinges, water damage) may be hidden by dust/dirt or camera angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides, corners, and the disc/cassette bays from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic condition matches visible heavy dust/grime, i.e. poor

proof_requests: A video clip showing the unit powered on, with CD/cassette playing and sound audible.
A clear photo of the included power adapter and its plug type.
Close-up photos of all panel buttons, display, and any physical damage or cracks.
A photo of the rear panel showing ports, voltage rating, and any UK import markings.
response.reason: The seller's own text is self-contradictory, calling the unit scrap/non-functioning in the description while also claiming it is fully working with no dead key or crackle, which is a classic sign of mismatched or misleading copy with no supporting proof.
